classification.difficultyReason: Two linked routine steps with no scaffolding. The student first uses opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral (x opposite 72°), then reads the matching arrow marks as parallel sides and applies co-interior angles to get y. Spotting the parallel marks and chaining the two angle facts makes it harder than the guided proof fill-in or a one-step cyclic angle. It is slightly easier than the semicircle-through-centre task, where the diameter must be recognised and two triangles used. No unsignposted insight is needed.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

answer.worked:
Opposite angles are supplementary.
$$\begin{aligned}x+72^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=108^\circ\end{aligned}$$
Co-interior angles on parallel lines are supplementary.
$$\begin{aligned}y+108^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=72^\circ\end{aligned}$$
